label: Water jet
description: Stateful water fountain (docs/RenderEngine.md §5.8): droplets leave a nozzle inside a narrow cone, arc over under gravity against drag, and are absorbed by the pool they land in — the impact damps them, scatters them sideways and shortens their remaining life, so the fall reads as water meeting water. Sprites are stretched along their own screen-space velocity and coloured by speed (foam-white leaving the nozzle, thin blue on the way down), which is what separates spray from a cloud of dots. Particle-only, alpha blended: unlike the additive stateless fountain companion it does not blow out to white where the jet is deep. Bind with an Object- or Instance-scope Appearance, or set the Shader's Demo shape.
